description: We are an interdisciplinary team of students from different universities and backgrounds, united by a passion for technology, innovation, and space exploration. Our team combines expertise in AI, Data Science, Software Development, IT, Cybersecurity, Research, and Problem Solving. By bringing diverse perspectives together, we aim to turn complex challenges into innovative, practical solutions with real-world impact.
summary:
**Marswalk Mission Planner** is an interactive Mars exploration system designed to support future astronaut missions. The project focuses on Jezero Crater, a scientifically important region of Mars and the landing site of NASA’s Perseverance rover.

The system combines a 2D mapping environment and a 3D Mars visualization, using real scientific datasets from NASA and other trusted sources, including satellite imagery and Digital Elevation Models (DEMs), to explore Martian terrain and elevation.

Users can examine locations, visualize terrain conditions, and plan routes between selected coordinates. The 3D environment provides an immersive way to explore Mars, from the global planet to the Jezero Crater region.

An integrated AI Agent enhances the system by understanding astronaut instructions, analyzing available terrain data, assisting with mission planning, and executing supported operations. For example, astronauts can request suitable routes between two locations based on distance and terrain conditions.

Ultimately, Marswalk Mission Planner aims to make Martian exploration more interactive, informed, and efficient by combining scientific data, geospatial analysis, 3D visualization, and AI-assisted operations.
details:
Marswalk Mission Planner is an interactive system designed to support future Mars exploration. It focuses on Jezero Crater and combines a 2D map, a 3D Mars environment, and an AI Agent. Users can explore the Martian surface, examine terrain data, and plan routes between selected coordinates. The AI Agent helps astronauts understand terrain conditions, plan missions, and perform tasks through instructions.

The project uses real NASA scientific datasets, including satellite imagery and elevation data, to provide more realistic exploration. We used Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, geospatial tools, and 3D visualization technologies.

Our goal is to make Mars exploration easier, safer, and more efficient. The creative aspect is bringing mapping, 3D visualization, scientific data, and AI-assisted operations together in one system. Our team considered terrain difficulty, route safety, data accuracy, usability, and the challenges astronauts may face on Mars.
